title: First visual set: emoji, icons, transitions, fonts, maps, doodles (tier A only)
notes: Only sources whose licence was read at the publisher and that allow keeping the files in an application's library (MIT, Apache-2.0, ISC, OFL-1.1, CC0, public domain, Unicode-3.0). sources.title: @iconify/json 2.2.561 - 280 icon sets in one package (MIXED licences: filter before use)

licence.custom: Mixed (MIT package; every icon set has its own licence)
licence.quote: This is collection of icon sets created by various authors. See collections.md for list of icon sets and their licenses.

sources.notes: Fetched as the package itself, unfiltered, so its registry integrity value covers every byte. THE EDITOR MUST FILTER SETS BY LICENCE before offering any icon: read collections.json and expose only sets whose licence.spdx is MIT, ISC, Apache-2.0 or CC0-1.0, and ALWAYS exclude Remix Icon (prefix "ri"): its upstream licence changed in January 2026 to "Remix Icon License v1.0", which forbids offering the icons as a downloadable collection, while the package metadata still says Apache-2.0. The package also holds CC-BY, CC-BY-SA, GPL, OFL and non-commercial sets; those stay unused. Because of that mix the package as a whole is marked diskOnly: it never enters the repository or a shared project archive; a single icon taken from an allowed set travels under that set's own licence. Counts read by the research on 2026-11-25: MIT 148 sets, Apache-2.0 31, CC0-1.0 10, ISC 4. Brand icons inside sets are trademarks.

licence.quote: MIT License / Copyright (c) 2017-present gl-transitions contributors [...] Note: Individual transitions in the transitions/ directory may have their own license specified in their file header comments. When no license is specified, the transition is covered by this MIT license.

sources.notes: Licence file read at the tip of the repository's main branch on 2026-11-25 (the registry entry names no source commit). Per the research report's reading of the package index: 225 transitions MIT, InvertedPageCurl BSD-3-Clause, StereoViewer BSD-2-Clause; every file names its author and licence in its header - keep the headers. Data for the editor's own WebGPU pass: each transition still has to pass the reference-pixel gate (ADR-0008) and the flash-safety check (ADR-0009) before it is offered. Nothing in the package is executed by the fetcher.

You may use the maps in any manner, including modifying the content and design, electronic dissemination, and offset printing. [...] No permission is needed to use Natural Earth. Crediting the authors is unnecessary.

sources.notes: Host: naciscdn.org, the CDN the publisher's own downloads page links to for its packages. The per-theme links on the publisher's pages answered HTTP 500 to a plain client on 2026-11-25; the same paths on the CDN serve the files. The archive URLs carry no version: versions are from the publisher's pages (rasters "version 3.2.0") and from the VERSION file inside the vector archives (cultural 5.1.2, physical 5.1.0). The publisher gives no checksums: the two vector archives are pinned to hashes computed here on 2026-11-25, the two rasters (88 MB each, above this worker's download limit) are pinned by exact size only and their hash is recorded as first seen. Unpacked sizes are exact, read from the archives' directories. Optional credit offered by the publisher: "Made with Natural Earth." Borders are politically sensitive: review the data's disputed-area layers before any border is drawn in a video.

sources.title: 26 Hebrew-capable font families from google/fonts (SIL OFL 1.1, no Reserved Font Name)

licence.quote: This Font Software is licensed under the SIL Open Font License, Version 1.1.

sources.notes: One checkout of google/fonts at the tip of main on 2026-11-25, sparse to one folder per family; every family folder holds its own OFL.txt with its own copyright line (the stored licence text is the Noto Sans Hebrew one). Checked at this commit: all 26 folders exist with OFL.txt, and none declares a Reserved Font Name. 177 files, 43.5 MB (exact, from the file sizes), plus the .git folder. Families: Playpen Sans Hebrew, Solitreo, Rubik Bubbles / Doodle Shadow / Wet Paint / Spray Paint / Scribble / Dirt / Glitch / Moonrocks, Noto Sans Hebrew, Open Sans, Miriam Libre, Arimo, Lunasima, Google Sans, M PLUS 1p, Noto Serif Hebrew, Noto Rashi Hebrew, Bellefair, Bona Nova, Bona Nova SC, Cardo, Libertinus Serif, Handjet, Cousine. Google Sans ships a TRADEMARKS.md: "Google" and "Google Sans" are trademarks; the font may be used, the names may not be used to imply affiliation. Left out: M PLUS Rounded 1c and Tinos (licence files not verified), Cascadia Code/Mono (Reserved Font Name). A family enters the editor's FONT_CATALOG only after the project's own glyph and nikud test and check:notices.
